研究对象: AWS

AWS 财务数据复核

口径说明

项目 口径
研究对象 AWS 指 Amazon 的 Amazon Web Services 分部；AWS 不是单独上市证券，Amazon.com, Inc. 2025 Form 10-K 以 AWS 分部披露净销售额、经营费用、经营利润、分部资产、property and equipment, net、total net additions to property and equipment 等项目。[S1]
未披露项处理 AWS 分部未披露独立 net income、gross profit、gross margin、net margin、shareholders' equity、segment debt、segment liabilities、segment OCF；这些指标在 AWS 单体口径标为 N/A。[S1]
替代分析指标 对 AWS 使用 operating income、operating margin、operating income / average segment assets、sales / average segment assets、property and equipment, net / sales、total net additions to property and equipment / sales 等分部可追溯指标。[S1][自测算]

1. 三年收入、净利润、毛利率、净利率趋势

指标 2023 2024 2025
AWS 净销售额 $90,757 million [S1] 07,556 million [S1] 28,725 million [S1]
AWS 经营费用 $66,126 million [S1] $67,722 million [S1] $83,119 million [S1]
AWS 经营利润 $24,631 million [S1] $39,834 million [S1] $45,606 million [S1]
AWS 经营利润率 27.1% [自测算：$24,631 million / $90,757 million] 37.0% [自测算：$39,834 million / 07,556 million] 35.4% [自测算：$45,606 million / 28,725 million]
AWS net income N/A；分部未披露 [S1] N/A；分部未披露 [S1] N/A；分部未披露 [S1]
AWS gross margin N/A；分部未披露 [S1] N/A；分部未披露 [S1] N/A；分部未披露 [S1]
AWS net margin N/A；分部未披露 [S1] N/A；分部未披露 [S1] N/A；分部未披露 [S1]
Amazon 合并 gross margin，仅作披露主体参考 47.0% [自测算：($574,785 million - $304,739 million) / $574,785 million；输入来自 Amazon consolidated net sales 与 cost of sales] 48.9% [自测算：($637,959 million - $326,288 million) / $637,959 million；输入来自 Amazon consolidated net sales 与 cost of sales] 50.3% [自测算：($716,924 million - $356,414 million) / $716,924 million；输入来自 Amazon consolidated net sales 与 cost of sales]
Amazon 合并 net margin，仅作披露主体参考 5.3% [自测算：$30,425 million / $574,785 million；输入来自 Amazon consolidated net income 与 net sales] 9.3% [自测算：$59,248 million / $637,959 million；输入来自 Amazon consolidated net income 与 net sales] 10.8% [自测算：$77,670 million / $716,924 million；输入来自 Amazon consolidated net income 与 net sales]

2. ROE / ROA / ROIC 分析

指标 2023 2024 2025 解释
AWS ROE N/A [S1] N/A [S1] N/A [S1] AWS 分部未披露独立 shareholders' equity。[S1]
AWS ROA / ROIC 代理值：operating income / average segment assets 25.0% [自测算：$24,631 million / (($88,491 million + 08,533 million) / 2)] 30.1% [自测算：$39,834 million / ((08,533 million + 55,953 million) / 2)] 22.3% [自测算：$45,606 million / ((55,953 million + $252,588 million) / 2)] 使用 AWS segment assets 替代投入资本；不是 GAAP ROIC。[S1][S2]
AWS 资产周转率代理值：sales / average segment assets 0.92x [自测算：$90,757 million / (($88,491 million + 08,533 million) / 2)] 0.81x [自测算：07,556 million / ((08,533 million + 55,953 million) / 2)] 0.63x [自测算：28,725 million / ((55,953 million + $252,588 million) / 2)] 2025 年资产扩张快于收入扩张。[S1][S2][自测算]
Amazon 合并 ROE，仅作披露主体参考 17.5% [自测算：$30,425 million / ((46,043 million + $201,875 million) / 2)] 24.3% [自测算：$59,248 million / (($201,875 million + $285,970 million) / 2)] 22.3% [自测算：$77,670 million / (($285,970 million + $411,065 million) / 2)] Amazon 合并口径，不等同 AWS 单体。[S1][S3]
Amazon 合并 ROA，仅作披露主体参考 6.1% [自测算：$30,425 million / (($462,675 million + $527,854 million) / 2)] 10.3% [自测算：$59,248 million / (($527,854 million + $624,894 million) / 2)] 10.8% [自测算：$77,670 million / (($624,894 million + $818,042 million) / 2)] Amazon 合并口径，不等同 AWS 单体。[S1][S2]

3. 杠杆与偿债指标

指标 2023 2024 2025 解释
AWS segment assets 08,533 million [S1] 55,953 million [S1] $252,588 million [S1] AWS segment assets 主要包括 property and equipment、accounts receivable、operating leases。[S1]
AWS property and equipment, net $72,701 million [S1] 10,683 million [S1] 90,055 million [S1] AWS 分部固定资产净额。[S1]
AWS property and equipment, net / sales 80.1% [自测算：$72,701 million / $90,757 million] 102.9% [自测算：10,683 million / 07,556 million] 147.6% [自测算：90,055 million / 28,725 million] 资本密集度显著上升。[S1][自测算]
AWS total net additions to property and equipment $24,843 million [S2] $53,267 million [S2] $96,496 million [S1] 含 technology infrastructure assets 与未付款的非现金活动。[S1][S2]
AWS total net additions to property and equipment / sales 27.4% [自测算：$24,843 million / $90,757 million] 49.5% [自测算：$53,267 million / 07,556 million] 75.0% [自测算：$96,496 million / 28,725 million] 2025 年扩张强度高于 2023 和 2024。[S1][S2][自测算]
AWS segment debt N/A；分部未披露 [S1] N/A；分部未披露 [S1] N/A；分部未披露 [S1] Amazon 未按 AWS 分部披露债务。[S1]
AWS current ratio N/A；分部未披露 [S1] N/A；分部未披露 [S1] N/A；分部未披露 [S1] Amazon 未按 AWS 分部披露流动资产与流动负债。[S1]
Amazon 合并 current ratio，仅作披露主体参考 1.05x [自测算：72,351 million / 64,917 million] 1.06x [自测算：90,867 million / 79,431 million] 1.05x [自测算：$229,083 million / $218,005 million] Amazon 合并口径，不等同 AWS 单体。[S1][S3]
Amazon 合并 long-term debt / total assets，仅作披露主体参考 11.0% [自测算：$58,314 million / $527,854 million] 8.4% [自测算：$52,623 million / $624,894 million] 8.0% [自测算：$65,648 million / $818,042 million] Amazon 合并口径，不等同 AWS 单体。[S1][S3]
Amazon 合并 long-term debt / equity，仅作披露主体参考 28.9% [自测算：$58,314 million / $201,875 million] 18.4% [自测算：$52,623 million / $285,970 million] 16.0% [自测算：$65,648 million / $411,065 million] Amazon 合并口径，不等同 AWS 单体。[S1][S3]
Amazon 合并 long-term debt + long-term lease liabilities / total assets，仅作披露主体参考 25.7% [自测算：($58,314 million + $77,297 million) / $527,854 million] 20.9% [自测算：($52,623 million + $78,277 million) / $624,894 million] 18.7% [自测算：($65,648 million + $87,339 million) / $818,042 million] Amazon 合并口径，不等同 AWS 单体。[S1][S3]

5. 关键财务指标 vs 行业平均

指标 AWS 2025 云基础设施可比平均 差异 口径说明
净销售额 / revenue 28,725 million [S1] $82,485 million [自测算：(06,265 million + $58,705 million) / 2] +$46,240 million [自测算：28,725 million - $82,485 million] 可比平均由 Microsoft Intelligent Cloud FY2025 revenue 与 Alphabet Google Cloud 2025 revenue 简单平均；仅作 AWS 可比公司参照。[S4][S5][自测算]

分部净利润披露 N/A [S1] N/A [S4][S5] N/A AWS、Microsoft Intelligent Cloud、Google Cloud 均以 segment operating income 为主要盈利披露口径。[S1][S4][S5]

House View 关系

机构 thesis 本步骤结论
th_p_a9368e4d Hyperscaler 多区域分散化对冲策略 本步骤确认但不提高 conviction：AWS 2025 年净销售额为 28,725 million、经营利润为 $45,606 million，且 AWS segment assets 从 2024 年 55,953 million 增至 2025 年 $252,588 million，说明 AWS 仍在以高资本强度扩张基础设施能力。[S1] 但 2025 年 AWS total net additions to property and equipment / sales 达 75.0%，且 operating income / average segment assets 从 2024 年 30.1% 降至 2025 年 22.3%，显示多区域/基础设施扩张的财务回报需要持续跟踪。[S1][自测算] 立场方向不变，conviction 不变。
